title: 13 Best Herbal Tinctures For Chickenpox
intro: Herbal tinctures for Chickenpox are liquid extracts made from various herbs and plants that have anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antiseptic properties, used to treat the symptoms and accelerate recovery from this viral infection. The benefits of using herbal tinctures to treat Chickenpox include reduced itching and inflammation, faster healing of sores, and a shorter duration of the illness. Some popular herbal tinctures used to treat Chickenpox include Echinacea, which boosts the immune system, Calendula, which soothes and calms the skin, and Oregano, which has antiviral properties that help combat the virus. Additionally, herbal tinctures such as Turmeric, Aloe Vera, and Lavender are also used to alleviate the discomfort and pain associated with Chickenpox, while herbs like Garlic and Ginger are known for their antiviral and antibacterial properties that help prevent secondary infections.
